coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Edgewater
record.summary: A six-story, 193-unit apartment building at 355 Berry Street in Mission Bay North (Assessor block 8707 lot 003, class Apartment 15 Units or more, built 2007). Its footprint is on the north bank of Mission Creek on the OCII land use map and OSM.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. Correction 2026-09-29: 355 Berry is a single Assessor parcel (8707003, active) in DataSF's Assessor parcel data, not condo-mapped; the condo-mapped lots on this block are 325 Berry (111) and 335 Berry (67), and the earlier condo-mapping statement, with its comparison to other condo-mapped towers, was wrong for this building. The footprint is the real OSM building outline.

changes.text: The map notes called Edgewater a condo complex made of many per-unit lots; 355 Berry is a single Assessor parcel classed as an apartment building, so those statements were corrected. The old note that year built and unit count were unconfirmed now cites the Assessor (2007, 193 units) and the permit (194 units). The summary no longer says 'rental', its location is attributed to the map and OSM, an earlier change entry now names permit #200502085025, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.

open_questions: Developer and architect not confirmed by any source found as of 2026-09-29, consistent with the notes on this record's map shape.
Precise opening month not available; DataSF's Assessor tax roll gives only a year.

A listing site's '6 units' figure (noted on this record's map shape) reads as a floorplan-type count, not the building's 193-unit total per the Assessor tax roll -- flagged there rather than reconciled here.

The 2005 construction permit's own unit count (194) is one more than the Assessor's 193 -- likely a manager's unit counted differently between filing and final tax-roll record, not a different building; not further reconciled here.
